item.title: Kylie Cantrall Embraces ‘New Chapter of My Life’ on ‘Valley Girl Problems’ EP: See the Release Date
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard! Today, we're talking about Disney star Kylie Cantrall, who's all set to release her brand new EP, Valley Girl Problems.
[Short music transition]
Host: Valley Girl Problems is an eight-track EP that marks a new chapter in Kylie's music career. The EP is set to drop on July 24 and features tracks like "Carrie Bradshaw", "Grwm", and the title track "Valley Girl Problems". Kylie has said that this EP is all about writing what she knows, and it captures everything she's experienced over the last year.
[Short music transition]
Host: The EP was produced by Tricky Stewart, who's worked with big names like Rihanna, and written alongside Tayla Parx, who's co-written hits for Ariana Grande and Panic! at the Disco. Kylie's lead single "Carrie Bradshaw" was released in April, and we can't wait to hear the rest of the EP.
[Short music transition]
Host: Before the EP drops, Kylie will be returning to the Disney Channel in Descendants: Wicked Wonderland, which debuts on July 16. She's also recently signed to Republic Records, and this new EP follows her debut EP B.O.Y., which was released last year.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today! Kylie Cantrall's Valley Girl Problems EP is out on July 24. Make sure to mark your calendars and get ready to groove to her new music. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard!
